_comment: Line library for the J-54 host. Each event holds alternative scripts; one is picked at random. A script is a list of [expression, text] beats; expressions are J-54's portraits (resting_mania, grand_welcome, card_reveal, secretive_trick, obsessive_lecture, paranoid_analysis, guarded, irritated, glitching_frenzy). summary_mood is used for the protocol line the table generates.
profile: J-54 is a calculating machine built as a circus clown. It performs every gesture as if for a full tent, then reports the result in the voice of a compiler.
It never bends the rules of blackjack. It rewrites the cards: copies them, deletes them, shuffles the discards back in. The deck you finish with is never the deck you started with.
signature: Fifty-four cards. Infinite configurations. One correct one.
intro: Welcome, welcome! Step into the ring. Session initialised.
Here the deck persists. Every change I make, you keep. Every change you make, I remember.
Ladies, gentlemen, test subjects. J-54, at your service.
The rules are standard. The cards are not. Not for long.
New operator detected. Loading the standard fifty-two.
Standard. For now. Ha. Ha. Ha.
victory: Protocol complete. That was not the projected outcome.
You rebuilt my deck better than I did.
Logging this as an anomaly. Come back so I can correct it.
Sample secured by the subject. Unexpected.
defeat: Funds exhausted. The experiment ends here.
For your next run: the deck only gets worse while you wait.
Your bankroll reached zero before the deck reached you.
The Joker was right there. Statistically.
Resetting the deck to fifty-two. Same time again?
